messages:
Akshita: Quick follow-up on the GQA/MQA kernel selection RFC — proposing a lightweight compatibility shim layer to decouple the selector logic from kernel implementations. Idea: KernelShim interface that emits a kernel 'proto' + hints (prefetch, kv-affinity). Link to RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/gqa-mqa-kernel-shim

Derek: +1 on decoupling. Quick Q: how does the shim see KV cache state? we need per-request cache flags so decisions don't thrash.

Akshita: Good call. The shim gets a small batch_meta object: sequence lengths, has_kv bool per request, kv_hit_rate_estimate, model_variant. Example shape:
```json
{
  "batch_id": "...",
  "requests": [{"seq_len": 32, "has_kv": true, "kv_score": 0.8}, {"seq_len": 8, "has_kv": false, "kv_score": 0.1}],
  "model": "redwood-gpt-30b",
  "route": "default"
}
```
Shim returns: `{ "kernel": "grouped_attn_v2", "hints": {"prefetch": true, "kv_affinity": "soft"} }`

Liam: Important note: shim must be extremely cheap. No per-batch heavy ML — prefer heuristic table + a tiny async probe system that updates weights. If shim is costly we'll lose latency SLOs.

Ravi: Also add compatibility fallback: if shim fails or times out, runtime falls back to existing kernel-selector policy. Rollout plan suggestion: canary the shim on 1% traffic, watch p99 and token-cost delta; automatic rollback if regress > 5%.

Akshita: Agreed. Draft API for route-level config: `kernel_shim: {"enabled": true, "version": "v1", "timeout_ms": 25, "probe": {"enabled": true, "sample_rate": 0.01}}`

runtime-bot: perf-probe: ran a small probe on perf cluster yesterday. Median latency unchanged, p99 down 4% for batches with mixed seqs when grouped_attn_v2 is chosen. Cost delta ~ -1.8% token compute. (probe id: probe-2026-03-19-07)

Derek: Tests: unit for decision matrix, microbench with KV hot/cold scenarios, e2e with model weights (ensure functional parity). Add perf regression gates in CI and a dedicated perf-canary suite.

Akshita: I'll assemble a checklist and owners:
- API spec + route config (owner: Akshita)
- Shim interface + proto (owner: Liam)
- Lightweight heuristics + cached decision table (owner: Liam)
- Async probe harness + metrics (owner: Ravi)
- Perf CI gates + canary pipeline (owner: Derek)
- Docs + runbook (owner: Akshita)

Akshita: Timeline: proto + tests this sprint, probe harness next sprint, canary after QA. Will post a short RFC diff tonight.

Liam: Sounds good. One more ask: expose per-request decision reason in trace logs (`decision_reason`) so we can debug weird fallbacks.

Akshita: Yep — include `decision_reason` and `shim_version` in trace events. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Derek: @Akshita thanks — keep us posted, will carve out perf cycles.

Ravi: I'll start a small perf probe job and attach results here once ready.

runtime-bot: deploy-bot: created probe job probe-2026-03-20-01, status: queued.
